title: Ruffle See-Through Ruffle Sleeve Wedding Guest Dress
descriptionHtml:
Turn heads at the wedding in this enchanting dress! Featuring delicate ruffle tulle sleeves and a flowing silhouette, this romantic design is perfect for celebrating love in style. Its timeless elegance ensures you'll feel confident and radiant all night long!


Tips: Slightly stretchy; prioritize the bust measurement when selecting a size.

 

Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Midi.


Sleeve Style: Ruffle sleeve.


Closure: Back zipper.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises tulle.


Stretch: Fabric is slightly stretchy.
